class.name: VertexBenchmarkRunner
class.brief_description: Collects per-frame metrics for named workloads and computes aggregates.
class.description: Spawn a workload (sprites, particles, tilemaps, physics bodies, large scenes, textures, UI, mobile workloads) from scripting, then call [method record_sample] once per frame and [method finalize_workload] to compute min/max/avg FPS, avg frame time, draw calls, texture/video memory and static memory. Use [method mark_startup_start] / [method mark_startup_end] to measure cold-start time. Run after every major change to detect regressions.

method.name: finalize_workload
method.description: Computes and stores the aggregate for the given workload, returning it.

method.name: mark_startup_start
method.description: Marks the start of a startup-time measurement.

method.name: record_sample
method.description: Records one frame of performance counters for the named workload. Call once per frame during the workload.

method.name: sample_now
method.description: Returns the current performance counters (FPS, frame time, draw calls, memory, etc.) without recording.
